tools.devsim: DEVSIM 2.11.0 (Apache-2.0), own models via the DEVSIM model API, own tensor grid
tools.optics: eoref.fmode vector FEM N2/P2, gmsh mesh (half window, TE mirror, PEC)

electron_phosphorus.locator: Masetti 1983 eq. (1) p. 765, Table I p. 766 phosphorus column

hole_boron.locator: Masetti 1983 eq. (4) p. 767, Table I p. 766 boron column; alpha 0.719 (+-0.013), mu0, mumax, C_r, P_c confirmed in Thurber et al. NBS SP 400-64 (1981) Table 13 p. 40, 300 K; beta 2.00 read from a partly lost scan glyph

models.srh: Shockley and Read 1952 eq. (4.4), (5.4); n1 = p1 = n_i
models.statistics: Boltzmann, complete ionisation, no bandgap narrowing, no Auger

soref_bennett_1550.locator: Reed et al., Nat. Photonics 4, 518 (2010), p. 519 (1.55 um expressions, attributed to Soref and Bennett 1987); Soref and Bennett, IEEE JQE 23, 123 (1987) Figs. 11, 14, 15, slopes p. 126

nedeljkovic_1550.locator: Nedeljkovic, Soref, Mashanovich, IEEE Photonics J. 3, 1171 (2011): eqs. (4), (5) p. 1175, Table 1 p. 1178, row 1.55 um (a 8.88E-21, b 1.167, c 5.84E-20, d 1.109, p 5.40E-22, q 1.011, r 1.53E-18, s 0.838); read from the rendered page image 2026-10-15 (references/_inbox/nedeljkovic2011.pdf)

definitions.V_pn: V(anode, p contact) - V(cathode, n contact); reverse bias < 0
definitions.C_F_cm: q |d N_e,tot / dV| per unit length (F/cm), N_e,tot = integral of n over the silicon, central difference dV = 2 mV; oxide included as Poisson-only dielectric (zero-flux outer boundary)
definitions.C_si_only_F_cm: same with the oxide removed (zero normal flux on all silicon surfaces)
definitions.U: U_mesh (round-2 rule, p_formal 2, three finest ES levels in h_A; every grid spacing and grading excess scales with h_A) + U_dV (|C(2dV)-C(dV)|/3) + U_ox (|C(oxide spacing / 2) - C| at the second-finest level, oxide variant only)
definitions.dn_Si: f(N_e(V), N_h(V)) - f(N_e(0), N_h(0)) with f the absolute-density fit (primary); secondary: f applied to the density changes, sign-preserving
definitions.d_eps: 2 n_Si (dn + i lambda d alpha / (4 pi)), Si only, mirrored half-window average
definitions.dneff_re: Re of int E* . d eps . E dA / (4 P'), first order, unperturbed TE0
definitions.dalpha_mode_cm: 4 pi Im(dn_eff) / lambda, cm^-1 (power), change relative to 0 V
definitions.alpha_mode_cm: absolute free-carrier modal loss at V from f_alpha(N(V)) (doping-induced, incl. contacts)
definitions.optics_value: ES-extrapolated value at the main optical mesh (h_j = 0.005 um) + (h_j-extrapolated - h_j finest at the finest ES level)
definitions.optics_U: U_es + U_hj + |h_core 28 nm - 40 nm| at the finest ES level + U_ox (oxide-halving check)

gate_roles.C_si_only_F_cm: primary C' gate (no oxide; insensitive to the electrostatic domain)
gate_roles.C_F_cm: secondary C' gate, valid only on the identical electrostatic domain (comparison_conditions); +1.3 % (0 V) to +2.6 % (-4 V) for BOX bottom -4 um / cladding top 4.22 um (audit Q2, K = 35)
gate_roles.dneff_re, dalpha_mode_cm, alpha_mode_cm,: primary optical gates (primary dn_Si definition); domain sensitivity ~2-3e-4 relative (audit Q2)

comparison_conditions.outer_boundary: zero normal flux (homogeneous Neumann) on all four outer edges, oxide and silicon
comparison_conditions.substrate: not modelled (no silicon below the BOX, no ground plane)
comparison_conditions.contacts: anode on the silicon slab end face x = -2.5 um, y in [0, 0.09] um (p+); cathode on x = +2.5 um, y in [0, 0.09] um (n+); ideal ohmic (charge-neutral equilibrium n, p; psi = V + V_t ln(n_eq/n_i)); 1.25 um of p+ / n+ between each contact and the p / n edge (x = -+1.25 um)
comparison_conditions.contact_corner_nodes: the 4 oxide nodes at the contact corners are not tied to silicon (DEVSIM keeps contact nodes out of interfaces); effect <= 1.6e-5 relative on C' (audit Q7)
comparison_conditions.bias: anode swept, cathode at the 0 V reference (plus the constant gauge offset), V_pn = V_anode
comparison_conditions.optics: same geometry, PEC window x in [-2.5, 2.5], y in [-1.5, 1.72] um, half window with TE mirror
